title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Friday, 6 November 2026
description: A brutal overnight tech sell-off wipes $2.3 trillion off markets, a political fight erupts over where Australia's data centres should be built, Queensland's $32 billion Western Downs data centre secures a builder and power link, and the Gold Coast records its hottest November day in 30 years alongside an overnight blackout. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made for your afternoon drive.
